description: Create a new IAM role. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the role

isMyAccount.description: Whether the role applies to the current account

roleName.description: Role name (3-100 chars, letters/numbers/special chars . _ -, must start with letter)

roleType.description: Role type: Server (VPC server), Account (console/portal access), Service (inter-service access)

sessionExpirationSec.description: Session expiration time in seconds (600, 1800, 3600, or 10800). Not allowed for Server type.

name: ncloud_create_role
